results.name: Disable Insecure HTTP Server
results.description: HTTP management interfaces transmit data in cleartext and must be disabled. Use HTTPS or SSH instead.

results.name: Enable SSH / Disable Telnet
results.description: Telnet transmits credentials in cleartext. All management access must use SSH only.

results.name: Enable NTP Time Synchronization
results.description: Accurate system time is critical for log correlation, certificate validation, and forensic investigation.

results.name: Enable Logging / Syslog
results.description: All network devices must forward logs to a central syslog server for SIEM integration and audit trails.

results.name: Disable SNMP v1/v2 (Use SNMPv3)
results.description: SNMPv1 and v2 use community strings instead of authentication. SNMPv3 with auth/priv must be used.

results.name: Disable Insecure HTTP Server
results.description: HTTP management interfaces transmit data in cleartext and must be disabled. Use HTTPS or SSH instead.
results.remediation:
configure terminal
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
end
write memory

results.name: Enable SSH / Disable Telnet
results.description: Telnet transmits credentials in cleartext. All management access must use SSH only.
results.remediation:
configure terminal
line vty 0 4
transport input ssh
login local
exit
crypto key generate rsa modulus 2048
end
write memory

results.name: Enable NTP Time Synchronization
results.description: Accurate system time is critical for log correlation, certificate validation, and forensic investigation.
results.remediation:
configure terminal
ntp server 0.pool.ntp.org
ntp server 1.pool.ntp.org
end
write memory

results.name: Enable Logging / Syslog
results.description: All network devices must forward logs to a central syslog server for SIEM integration and audit trails.
results.remediation:
configure terminal
logging on
logging host 10.0.0.100
logging trap informational
end
write memory

results.name: Disable SNMP v1/v2 (Use SNMPv3)
results.description: SNMPv1 and v2 use community strings instead of authentication. SNMPv3 with auth/priv must be used.
results.remediation:
configure terminal
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
snmp-server group SNMPV3GROUP v3 priv
end
write memory
